\par\vspace{0.35em}\footnotesize\noindent Notes: The simulation program assigns each measure to a tax, subsidy/rebate, or administered-price family and calibrates one measure-specific intensity parameter so that the geometric mean of its monthly implied price ratios matches the audited ratio reported here. Sources: Bruegel Dataset (2021), `National policies to shield consumers from rising energy prices,' version of 26 June 2023; authors' calculations.
